mostWorthwhile.text: Combining pyruvate and oxygen to show aerobic ATP renewal was most worthwhile: the planned illustration separates fuel oxidation, oxygen's role and the hydrogen-ion gradient driving ATP synthase.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the pump was a predictable preparation rather than an interesting decision on its own, although it set up the useful comparison with passive transport.

surprise.text: The pump result clarified how active transport helps maintain differences that passive sodium movement would reduce.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but choosing aerobic ATP rather than glycolytic ATP for the pump and protein steps felt somewhat arbitrary: both were offered as compatible options.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how these cellular processes connect to larger structures; the fuel-to-ATP and active-versus-passive transport explanations made this chapter worthwhile.
